abilities.name: intimidate
abilities.effect: Lowers opponents' Attack one stage upon entering battle.

abilities.name: anger-point
abilities.effect: Raises Attack to the maximum of six stages upon receiving a critical hit.

abilities.name: sheer-force
abilities.effect: Strengthens moves with extra effects to 1.3× their power, but prevents their extra effects.

kanto.flavorText: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

original-johto.flavorText: These violent POKéMON fight with other mem­ bers of their herd in order to prove their strength.

hoenn.flavorText: It is not satisfied unless it is rampaging at all times. If there is no opponent for TAUROS to battle, it will charge at thick trees and knock them down to calm itself.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.

updated-johto.flavorText: After heightening its will to fight by whipping itself with its three tails, it charges at full speed.

original-unova.flavorText: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.

updated-unova.flavorText: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.

kalos.flavorText: When it is about to tackle, it whips its body repeatedly with its three long tails.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: This Pokémon is not satisfied unless it is rampaging at all times. If there is no opponent for Tauros to battle, it will charge at thick trees and knock them down to calm itself.

original-alola.flavorText: Although it’s known to be a fierce Pokémon, Tauros in the Alola region are said to possess a measure of calmness.

updated-alola.flavorText: The climate seems to be related to the reason Tauros in Alola are a little calmer than those in other regions.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: A rowdy Pokémon with a lot of stamina. Once running, it won’t stop until it hits something.

swsh.flavorText: The Tauros of the Galar region are volatile in nature, and they won’t allow people to ride on their backs.
